name: sifa-mcp
description: MCP server for portable reputation and skills passports across Africa
author: Gabriel Mahia

tools.name: create_worker_profile
tools.description: Create a portable worker reputation profile. Western parallel: LinkedIn profile creation, Angie's List contractor profile. This is the 'economic passport' that travels with the worker. DEMO — no real identity verification in this prototype.

tools.name: add_service_record
tools.description: Add a completed service record to a worker's profile. Western parallel: Uber trip completion, Angie's List job review, Upwork completed contract. Each record builds the reputation score. DEMO — client verification is simulated.

tools.name: get_reputation_profile
tools.description: Retrieve a worker's full reputation profile including trust score. Western parallel: Checking a contractor's BBB rating or Upwork JSS. DEMO data.

tools.name: generate_reference
tools.description: Generate a structured professional reference letter for a worker. Western parallel: LinkedIn recommendation, employer reference letter. Outputs a formatted reference that can be printed, shared as PDF, or verified by QR code in production. DEMO.

tools.name: list_skill_categories
tools.description: List all skill categories and subcategories available in the Sifa system. Use this to see valid skill values for create_worker_profile.

tools.name: compare_workers
tools.description: Compare the reputation scores of multiple workers for a specific job. Western parallel: Contractor comparison on Thumbtack, Bark, or Houzz. DEMO data.
